summary: Comprehensive testing of CineMorph AI MVP. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed covering auth, languages, movies (CRUD), dubbing pipeline (create/progress/list/download), and analytics. Frontend: All pages load correctly (Landing, Login, Dashboard, Upload, Jobs, Downloads, Settings); protected-route redirect to /login works; authenticated cookie-based session loads dashboard with real analytics; the mock dubbing pipeline reached 100% Completed for the uploaded TEST_movie.mp4 (EN -> TA) and surfaced on Jobs/Downloads pages.

minor.issue: Could create duplicate session_token rows for same user on repeated /auth/session calls (no upsert on session_token). Low risk but pollutes user_sessions collection.
No validation that target_language is in supported LANGUAGES list; accepts arbitrary strings.
file_size limit not enforced; large uploads could exhaust disk. No max-size guard.

issues: User email is truncated with ellipsis but no title/tooltip on hover (minor UX).

action_items: (Optional) Validate target_language against LANGUAGES list in /api/dubbing/create
(Optional) Add max upload size guard in /api/movies/upload
(Optional) Upsert on session_token in /api/auth/session to avoid duplicates
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 465 lines - approaching limit; consider splitting into routers (auth, movies, dubbing, analytics) as it grows.
mock_ai_processing uses asyncio.create_task without persistence; if backend restarts mid-job, the job will be stuck in 'processing' forever. Consider a status-recovery path.
DubbingJob target_language is not validated against LANGUAGES enum.
No file-size cap on /api/movies/upload could allow disk exhaustion.
All MongoDB queries correctly use {'_id': 0} projection - good.
Auth flow correctly supports both Cookie and Bearer header - good.
CORS allow_origins falls back to '*' with allow_credentials=True; not strictly valid per spec when wildcards used with credentials. Recommend explicit origins.

rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found. All listed items are optional hardening suggestions.
